apps.name: Photos Backup
apps.localizedDescription:
## What's new

### Backups keep running after you leave the app
- New **Keep Running in Background** (Settings → Background), **on by default**.
- Without it, iOS pauses the app seconds after you switch away, so backups only moved while the app was open.
- Uses **Silent Audio** by default (no permission needed), or **Location** if calls or music keep taking the audio.
- Two uploads at a time until everything is backed up, then the app sleeps again. Each run stops itself after 12 hours.
- **Start a backup with the app open.** Swiping the app away from the app switcher stops it.
- It uses more battery; leaving the phone charging works best.
- With it off, the screen stays on while a backup runs with the app open.

### Backed-up photos stay remembered
- Favouriting a photo, moving it between albums, or iOS's own photo analysis no longer makes the app forget it was backed up.
- Before, these re-checked thousands of photos on every launch. Now only a real edit (a new edit or a revert) re-checks a photo.

### Built with Xcode 26
- Earlier releases, including 0.3.10, were built with Xcode 16.4, which left out the **iOS 26 continued backup** (the Live Activity, and continuing in the background on iOS 26). This release includes it.

### Lighter on large libraries
- Simultaneous uploads now check their files in parallel instead of one at a time.
- Far fewer disk writes during a large re-check.
- The Activity list shows what's in progress, the next 20 waiting and the latest 50 finished, and counts the rest.

### Credits
From [g8row/PhotosBackup](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup), by g8row and Josip Papež.

## Install
Unsigned IPA: sideload `PhotosBackup-iOS-0.3.11.ipa` with SideStore or AltStore, and check it against `PhotosBackup-iOS-0.3.11.ipa.sha256`.
